gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU (12 GB)

protocol.quality_checks: Nine probes once per depth, including three thinking probes
protocol.gpu_telemetry: One-second samples, saved per trial; not proof of exclusive GPU ownership
protocol.depth_selection: Extract image entrypoint, replace its single --spec-draft-n-max 2 value and matching status text, mount read-only; assert the actual /proc/1/cmdline value. No backend binary changes.
protocol.quality_checks_after_benchmark: Quality probes run after each depth in block 3, outside measured conversation time.

limitations: Approximately 16k cumulative API usage, not a filled 16k unique context.
MTP=4 answers differ from MTP=1/2; decode rate and elapsed time have different output lengths.
Greedy batched verification may change near-tied choices; the exact cause of changed answers was not profiled.
Short quality probes do not establish broad quality equivalence.
Default MTP=2 is unchanged; results are workload and host specific.

off_protocol.order: Three consecutive fresh-container trials after the rotated MTP depth series; not interleaved.
off_protocol.model_file_unchanged: Same MTP Lean model, no claim of removing its unused MTP weights or saving VRAM.
